text: 粤芯半导体公告称，公司发行的人民币普通股股票将于2026年10月13日在深圳证券交易所创业板上市。本次发行价格为12.01元/股，发行后总股本为28.78亿股(超额配售选择权行使前)，公开发行股票数量为5.13亿股，全部为新股。
text_en: CanSemi announced that the RMB ordinary shares issued by the company will be listed on the ChiNext Board of the Shenzhen Stock Exchange on October 13, 2026. The issue price is 12.01 yuan per share, and the total share capital after issuance is 2.878 billion shares (before the exercise of the over-allotment option), with 513 million shares publicly issued, all of which are new shares.
